usage: Three nine-panel illustration atlases extracted and optimized as local WebP assets.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single production illustration atlas for a children's picture book website, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equally sized square scene panels, no gutters, no borders, no writing. Render at the highest practical resolution, ideally 3072x3072. All nine scenes use the SAME characters in gentle luminous hand-painted watercolor and colored pencil, warm ivory paper, aqua water, coral accents, expressive friendly faces. Miri is a four-year-old girl with short curly dark-brown hair, warm light-medium skin, wearing coral clothes for cycling and a coral one-piece swimsuit at the pool; Abba is her dad, dark curly hair and short beard. Ayla is a little girl with two dark ponytails, mustard swimsuit. Asher is a little boy with dark hair, teal swim shirt. Adults supervise ALL swimming, a kind woman swimming instructor is in the water close beside the children. Illustrate these nine panels in precise reading order: top left cover scene Miri holding goggles smiling at a sparkling indoor pool; top center Miri safely helmeted and strapped into a proper rear child seat on helmeted Abba's bicycle traveling a leafy neighborhood path; top right the three cousins and Abba arriving outside a friendly YMCA community pool building (no text on signs); middle left cousins sitting at shallow pool edge looking a little nervous while instructor reaches reassuringly from water; middle center Miri and cousins blowing bubbles in shallow water beside instructor; middle right practicing kicking at pool edge under instructor supervision, happy little splashes; bottom left instructor supporting Miri floating on her back while cousins watch at edge; bottom center dreamlike future scene of a sunny supervised pool party, Miri making a small jump from LOW pool edge into waiting instructor's hands, distant unused diving board signifies a future skill; bottom right Miri wrapped in fluffy coral towel with Ayla and Asher, Abba giving a warm hug. Keep panel compositions independent, complete, distinct, safe and uncluttered. No text, typography, panel numbers, logos, speech bubbles or watermarks.
